violation_type.title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))
violation_type.short_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded
violation_type.typical_finding: A large unmounted fan was accessible to children. This was corrected during the inspection when the director turned off the fan and removed it from the area.

finding_variants.text: A large unmounted fan was accessible to children. This was corrected during the inspection when the director turned off the fan and removed it from the area.
A fan was observed in use on top of a shelf in the infant classroom.    Note: This was corrected when removed from the classroom.

Children were participating in physical activity at the operation's gym, the gym has two fans and one of them was on and accessible to children.     There are two wooden storage boxes without ventilation holes with an outdoor latch that could close and trap a child inside. The boxes are in the gym and accessible to children.
A boxed fan was observed on a top shelf, not mounted, while children were sleeping in the TV room.     NOTE: Corrected at inspection when it was removed.
During the inspection, the fencing around the AC units on the playground have holes and are in need of repair.
A fan was observed plugged in on top of a counter in the school age classroom.     Note: A photo was taken and this was corrected during inspection.
